seo.ogTitle: Contact Ozony Tech | IT & Network Support
seo.ogDescription: Need help with business Wi-Fi, network setup, firewall configuration, or IT support? Contact Ozony Tech today.

hero.title: Need IT or network help for your business?
hero.description: Tell us what you need help with and Ozony Tech will help you figure out the right next step — whether that is business Wi-Fi, network setup, firewall configuration, IT support, or a full walkthrough.
hero.helper: Use the request form to send the details once. Ozony Tech will review the service type, location, urgency, and next best step before following up.

firewallSecurity.title: Firewall & Security

form.title: Send a request
form.description: Send your request directly to Ozony Tech. No email app needed.
form.urgencyHelp: This helps Ozony Tech prioritize business-impacting issues.
form.messagePlaceholder: Tell us what is going on, what you need installed, fixed, upgraded, or planned.
form.consent: I agree that Ozony Tech may contact me by phone, text, or email about my request. Calls may be recorded and summarized so the team can follow up accurately. *

details.title: Contact details
details.serviceAreaText: NYC, New Jersey, Connecticut, and nearby small business locations.
details.bestForText: New installs, upgrades, troubleshooting, Wi-Fi cleanup, firewall setup, and small business IT planning.

next.title: What happens next?
next.description: The goal is to make the first step simple. You do not need to know all the technical details yet. Send the request, and Ozony Tech can help sort out the right path.

steps.submit: Submit your request with the details you already know.
steps.review: Ozony Tech reviews the setup, location, urgency, and service needs.
steps.followUp: We follow up with the best next step, quote, or walkthrough recommendation.

next.stepNote: Simple, practical, and built around the business need.
next.urgentNote: For urgent business network or Wi-Fi issues, include as much detail as possible: internet provider, router/firewall model, number of devices, business type, and what stopped working.
